digest.component_or_area: plan vocabulary and criteria heading structure
propositions: The codebase maintains two separate headings (Success Criteria and Acceptance Criteria) for criteria that should be unified, with all criteria gates pooling both under one bar regardless of heading
Success Criteria items are stored as plain bullets and do not count toward P1 blocking floor, cannot carry [operator-attested] tag, and are not individually checkable, tightening the gate

106 store tickets carrying legacy ## Success Criteria headings must be migrated to ## Acceptance Criteria with checklist items, with zero SC headings and eight prose mentions remaining after migration
Detector regexes, reviewer prompts, criteria routing index, author guides, generated criteria guide, eval specs, and test corpus must all transition to unified Acceptance Criteria vocabulary

Four live source files legitimately retain success criteria wording outside scope: plan_review_T2.md (trial metrics), plan_review_verifier.md, plan_review_verifier_agentic.md (dod_uncertifiable), and completion.py
All child stories (S1-S6) must complete and their changes verified to pass lint, typecheck, pytest suite, with Verified +1 before epic closure
